player_prompt.intro:
Jumawa Player {player_id} uka pukara Indian Poker.
- 52-karta deck; jumawa uka karta k'arañapa.
- Ante {ante} ficha(s) kasta ronda, {max_rounds} ronda(s) tukuypa.
- K'araña validas: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X maya positivo <= jumawa q'ipinapa.)
- Karta escondida alaxpacha q'ipina pot uka showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Maya p'iqi q'illt'aña utjana, aka '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', ukatxa '[fold]' ukanaka.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: [bet X] ukampi jist'araña; janiw kuna apuestas utjkanti.
invalid_move.insufficient: Uka lurawitakix janiw chips ukanakax utjkiti.

message.showdown_tie: Showdown: paypacha {card}. Pot jaljtat sapa maynix katuqatawa {split}.
